strings.en:
Hail, my friend!

Tales of your recent deeds have reached as far as Hoelbrak, and the servants of your Order speak highly of the many things you have done. Already you prove that my faith in you is well-placed. 

As for myself, I have been traveling. I've been investigating the legend of a powerful sword, the match to Rytlock's, that may yet exist within the catacombs of Ascalon. Zojja still fights for Snaff's legacy, while Caithe roams the Caledon Forest, keeping her own counsel. I hear Logan's returned to Kryta. I suppose I should not be surprised. He fears for his Queen's safety, and rightly so. There are many who seek to destroy the treaty between the charr and the humans. We must stop them if we are to succeed in saving Tyria from the dragons.

You are doing well, Slayer. Continue on your path, and you will hear from me again very soon.

—Eir

"They're on to us. My sources say at least three of our sites have been compromised, possibly more. We need to be more careful.

These are the most critical records my followers have collected: I've enclosed copies for you in case my group is next. We need to isolate ourselves so that one discovery won't collapse the whole network.

This will be the last time I contact you. May we meet again, in a brighter future."

Performance Review for employee 44236: Mai Trin

Per the work agreement signed between Ms. Trin and Lady Joon, the review has been triggered by the fulfillment of Ms. Trin's probationary period of employment, and it is our recommendation that she be converted to full-time employment with Xunlai Jade.

Although unrefined in the area of technical acumen and with limited experience with practical jade tech applications, Ms. Trin has proven herself to be an excellent and adaptable employee, often outperforming her more senior colleagues at certain tasks, though this level of excellence can be sporadic.

Ms. Trin has demonstrated core competencies and a natural inclination toward leadership, which more than make up for the limitations she has with specific implementation and individual contributions.

Although Ms. Trin is new to Xunlai Jade, she has even impressed Lady Joon herself, though certain aspects of this dynamic remain within sealed documents to which this department does not have access.

Final Assessment: Recommended that employee 44236 be offered a full-time employment contract, and granted full access to Xunlai Jade "common" level facilities upon acceptance.

I... I'm okay. I need to keep reminding myself that I'm okay.  
  
We've retaken the Wizard's Tower since the first attack; I'll thank whatever spirit or god I can for that. But things in Amnytas are still grim. I feel completely useless in battle—can't stop thinking about when it happened. When Soo-Won...when she died. Aesor squeezed my hand to keep herself upright. At least two of my scholars passed out.  
  
We were inside the library listening to one of Isgarren's lectures on runic magic when the world started to rumble below—even from the clouds, we could hear the land crack and shake. We'd just settled where we are now. I thought the northern coast would be more peaceful than Janthir. Isgarren and Dagda raced to the Bastion of the Celestial, but it was already too late. Whatever surge of magic that erupted with the death of the Elder Mother crippled our magic. The beacons, the spire, and the tower—who knows what else shattered in the broken corners of the world. There was no hope of repairing them on time, not before...  
  
It didn't take long for the Kryptis to catch on. As soon as the spire faltered, they came right in. Balance was gone.
